cast: Original fictional ambient residents; contributor public-person casting remains separate.

residents.dialogue: Hold the brake for me? Thanks. People keep bringing these in with the same problem: hills.
residents.revisit: You made it back. Brake still works? That's my favorite kind of review.

residents.dialogue: I finally found a studio with a sink. It sounds like a small thing until you try carrying wet clay home.
These two know the route better than I do. We stop at every bakery, including the closed one.
I'm waiting for my brother. He said five minutes, so I've got time to eat.
Potrero is uphill from here. Bring a layer. Somehow that's still useful advice when it's sunny.
I came in for coffee and ran into three people I owed messages to. Productive morning, unfortunately.
You look like you've been walking awhile. Sit down; I can get your little team patched up.
Nothing fancy today. Just the stuff you wish you'd packed before you left home.

dogpatch.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

potrero_hill.landmark_brief: A stair landing with a city view

residents.dialogue: I bought one more bag than I can carry. I do this every single week.
residents.revisit: You're still taking the stairs? All right, now I feel lazy.

residents.dialogue: The sunny side gets tomatoes. The windy side gets whatever survives my optimism.
That address is one block away. The hill has a different opinion.
We're supposed to be going home. Apparently every staircase has to be counted first.
Take a second at the landing. Nobody ever looks back until they've already reached the top.
I had the perfect light ten minutes ago. Now I'm calling it a scouting trip.
Come in and catch your breath. The kettle's already on.
I put the heavy stuff by the register. People have enough hill left after they leave.

potrero_hill.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

residents.dialogue: Can you stand a little to the left? I'm checking whether that outline reads from the sidewalk.
residents.revisit: Oh, you came back. The wall's finished. The paint on my shoes is permanent.

residents.dialogue: My break is twelve minutes. I'd love to explain the whole menu, but right now I'm just eating.
I found the record I came for. Now I need someone to stop me buying four more.
The courtyard is quieter than the street. I take my lunch back there when I can.
Somebody left a note on my bike saying 'nice bike.' Honestly, it made my day.
I'm reading tonight. To maybe six people, but they're six people who actually listen.
You can rest here. No, you don't have to buy something first.
The line moves fast if everybody decides before they reach me. Nobody decides.

mission.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

residents.dialogue: We start in ten minutes. That includes the person who is definitely still choosing snacks.
residents.revisit: You came back! Different movie tonight. Same argument about the best seat.

residents.dialogue: He acts like he owns this whole block. I'm just the person carrying the bags.
I asked for something short and left with a trilogy. The staff are very good at their jobs.
Decaf is still coffee. I have this conversation more often than you'd think.
It's not for an event. I just wanted a jacket that made leaving the house feel worthwhile.
I keep meaning to move closer to work. Then I have a day like this and forget the whole idea.
Come sit for a minute. I'll take care of your team while you rest.
Need supplies? Take your time. The person behind you is only here to talk to my dog.

castro.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

residents.dialogue: It looked better from my window. It always looks better from my window.
residents.revisit: Still checking the water. One of us should probably get in eventually.

residents.dialogue: I was here before sunrise. So when I say good morning at two, just let me have it.
I used to open the arrival app every ten seconds. Now I stare down the street. Personal growth.
The plants on this side get fog. The ones on the other side also get fog.
We packed sunscreen and two jackets. I've stopped trying to predict which one we'll need.
The cafe knows my order. I'm choosing to find that comforting rather than embarrassing.
Come warm up. Wet sleeves, tired team, whatever it is, you're welcome.
Heading toward the park? Grab what you need now. It's a longer walk when you're hungry.

outer_sunset.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

marina.landmark_brief: A small bar and waterfront meeting spot

residents.dialogue: You can have water without explaining yourself. I promise that's the least interesting order I've heard.
residents.revisit: Back again? Your friends found you. They were standing outside the other bar.

residents.dialogue: I said this would be an easy run. Then my friend started talking about splits.
I know all the dogs on this block and almost none of the people. It seems to be working.
They moved the meeting because the first meeting ran long. I'm going for a walk.
She said 'leaving now.' I can see her apartment from here. The lights are still on.
We picked a bar so we could hear each other. Then we picked a different bar. Same problem.
Sit down, have some water. There's no rush to head back out.
Forgot something for the waterfront? If it's a jacket, I can only offer sympathy.

marina.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

residents.dialogue: The view is nice, but I mainly come up here because my phone gets quiet.
residents.revisit: You found the little overlook again. Please don't put it in a top-ten list.

residents.dialogue: I got three pages of instructions for a cat that won't acknowledge I exist.
I'm trying to get that window color right. It changes every time a cloud goes over.
I take this route home for the trees. It's a few minutes longer. I don't mind.
Our assignment was one building. I picked one with about a thousand details. Great choice.
The stairs are fine. It's people saying 'just a few stairs' that gets me.
There's a seat inside if you need a minute. Your team can rest too.
I know this shop is small. Somehow people still lose each other in it.

pacific_heights.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

residents.dialogue: I fixed the bug. Now I'm trying to write a comment that explains why it was a bug.
residents.revisit: The fix shipped. Someone immediately asked whether the old behavior could be an option.

residents.dialogue: The stroller has better suspension than my bike. I'm not sure how I got here.
We leave at the same time every day. He still reacts like this walk was his idea.
It's a good table for working. It's a terrible table for pretending you aren't working.
I used to hurry through this block. Now I know which bench gets the afternoon sun.
Bring the broken thing in. Worst case, we learn why it's broken together.
You can rest here while we look after your team. The chairs don't match, but they're comfortable.
Need a few supplies? I can help. Need directions? My neighbor will give you three versions.

noe_valley.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

residents.dialogue: I can't talk about work. I can tell you the sandwich downstairs is worth talking about.
residents.revisit: The project finally has a name. Somehow I preferred when it didn't.

residents.dialogue: I'm off shift. If you're asking where to get coffee, that I can help with.
My building has three apps and one front door. You can guess which one works reliably.
I'm checking the wind before I head out. Looking confident doesn't make the water calmer.
We booked a study room and spent the first hour choosing what to study.
It changes fast around here. I still use the old corner as a landmark.
Long walk along the water? Come in. We have space for your team.
Game day gets busy. The trick is to buy snacks before everybody else has the same idea.

mission_bay.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

residents.dialogue: Your ticket is fine. You're just walking toward the wrong entrance. Happens every game.
residents.revisit: Back for another one? I recognize the determined search for the snack stand.

residents.dialogue: I brought a jacket, a second jacket and completely unreasonable expectations.
If you want to know what's good, ask the person eating. I'm paid to say all of it.
She doesn't care who wins. She wants to know whether the big screen can see her.
I'm listening while I watch. My friend says that's strange. My friend keeps asking me what happened.
We came early to walk by the water. Now we're somehow late getting to our seats.
Need a quiet minute? Come in here. We can help your team recover too.
Last chance before you find your seat. Unless you're the person who gets up every inning.

giants_stadium.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

residents.dialogue: I blocked off lunch on my calendar. Someone invited me to a lunch meeting.
residents.revisit: That meeting could have been a message. The message could have been nothing.

residents.dialogue: Everyone asks if the lobby is open. During the day, yes. That's why the door is open.
I've got two stops left. Both say they're five minutes away. In opposite directions.
There's an empty table inside. People keep assuming we're full because of the line.
Requests are welcome. Knowing the song is a separate question.
I said I'd take a meeting outside for once. Now I can hear myself think. Weird feeling.
Come off the sidewalk for a minute. We'll get your team ready for the next stretch.
Lunch rush is over. You can actually see what's on the shelves now.

financial_district.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

residents.dialogue: You can browse. Really. You don't have to apologize every time you pick something up.
residents.revisit: Did you finish that book? You can say no. I haven't finished mine either.

residents.dialogue: I used to have a usual table. Then somebody else developed a usual table.
The dough decides when it's ready. I just explain the delay to everybody else.
We followed the smell of coffee. It's the best navigation system we've tried today.
I can hear somebody practicing the same song every night. They're getting better.
I'm early on purpose. Missing a boat feels much worse than missing a bus.
There's a quiet seat inside. Take a break before you head for the islands.
If you're going across the water, check your bag now. Coming back for one item gets old fast.

north_beach.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

residents.dialogue: Everybody asks about the view. It's lovely. I mostly want the bus to line up with my shift.
residents.revisit: You found us again. Come in if the wind picks up. It probably will.

residents.dialogue: I put the little plants behind the big plants. That's the entire wind strategy.
I took a hundred pictures and forgot to actually stand here for a minute.
Give yourself time to get back. A nice view is not a boat schedule.
The space was what I needed. I didn't realize how much until I had it.
We're collecting interesting rocks. So far, every rock has qualified.
Come inside and warm up. We'll get your team sorted before you head out.
The things people forget are always small. The inconvenience is never small.

treasure_island.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

residents.dialogue: That path gets quieter after the next turn. I take it when I've had enough advice from other gardeners.
residents.revisit: You're back. Nothing dramatic happened. That can be a pretty good day.

residents.dialogue: I came out for half an hour and forgot to turn around. The trees make that easy.

golden_gate_park.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

residents.dialogue: I brought a hat. The hill has custody of it now.
residents.revisit: Still no hat. Nice view, though.

residents.dialogue: I live close enough to see this place and still forget how windy it is up here.

twin_peaks.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

residents.dialogue: If you hear a hum, that's normal. If I start running, then you can ask questions.
residents.revisit: The equipment is fine. The coffee machine is the emergency today.

residents.dialogue: I use the tower to figure out where I am. Standing this close has ruined my whole system.

sutro_tower.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

residents.dialogue: I'm waiting for the fog to lift. If it doesn't, I'll call the fog the point of the walk.
residents.revisit: Still fog. Still worth coming out.

residents.dialogue: Stay on the path, please. The good view doesn't need you to stand on the edge.

lands_end.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending

residents.dialogue: Check your water before the climb. It sounds obvious until you're halfway up.
residents.revisit: You made it back down. Take a moment before you start telling the story.

residents.dialogue: We said we'd stop at the next nice view. We've stopped six times.

angel_island.status: authored dialogue candidate; in-game review pending
